get.description: Reads events populated by the ClickUp webhook receiver: status transitions, moves, assignee changes, task creations and deletions. Scoped to the caller's own subscription for the workspace. If no subscription exists, returns 200 with kind='no-subscription' + a warning — not 404 — so digests can gracefully fall back to filterTeamTasks with dateUpdatedGt.

get.description: Cross-references the local subscription record against ClickUp's own view of the webhook and the event store. Detects endpoint-URL drift (BASE_URL changed between subscribe and now), orphaned ClickUp webhook (local record points at a webhook ClickUp deleted), event-bundle mismatch, ClickUp fail_count exceeding our stored fail_count (ingestion route silently 200-ing on thrown errors), disabled-webhook status, and the 'zero events with zero delivery failures' pattern that means deliveries either are not reaching the ingestion route or are being silently swallowed. Returns 200 even for broken states.

post.summary: Re-host an image and get a public URL

CreateTimeEntryRequest.description: Provide issueId OR projectId; a body with neither is rejected with 400 rather than spending a 422 round-trip.

spentOn.description: Defaults to today on the Redmine side.

activityId.description: Required unless the instance has a default.

userId.description: Log on behalf of another user. Needs the log-time-for-other-users permission.

UpdateWikiPageRequest.description: projectId and title come from the path and win over the same keys here.

text.description: Full page body. REPLACES the existing content entirely — this is the field the 5 MB body limit exists for.

parentTitle.description: Title of the parent wiki page, to nest this one under it.

version.description: Version being edited, for optimistic locking. A mismatch is rejected by Redmine instead of clobbering a concurrent edit.

modifiedTime.description: When the spreadsheet was last modified

sheets.description: List of sheets in the spreadsheet

index.description: The index of the sheet within the spreadsheet

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the sheet

columnCount.description: Number of columns in the sheet

revisionId.description: The revision ID of the presentation

objectId.description: The object ID of the page

pageType.description: The type of the page (SLIDE, MASTER, LAYOUT)

pageElements.description: The page elements on this page

objectId.description: The object ID of the page element

size.description: The size of the page element

transform.description: The transform of the page element
